raw_translation: Calculator hutumia kuchapishwa ZXQPH0000QXZ eneo kiwango kwa ajili ya shughuli ya kawaida au kilimo / uvuvi. Inaongeza kuingia likizo malipo, fidia kodi na mchango wowote wa pensheni kwa msingi mchango. Kwa ajili ya shughuli ya kawaida katika eneo Ia, ZXQPH0001QXZ NOK kwa kila-biashara tofauti malipo ni kutumika kwa kiasi aliingia kama tayari kutumika mwaka huu. Matokeo ni makadirio ya kila mwaka mipango; mahali mfanyakazi aliyesajiliwa na shughuli kuamua sheria zinazotumika.
source: The calculator uses the published 2026 zone rate for ordinary activity or agriculture/fishing. It adds entered holiday pay, taxable compensation and any pension contribution to the contribution basis. For ordinary activity in zone Ia, the 850,000 NOK per-enterprise differential allowance is applied to the amount entered as already used this year. Results are annual planning estimates; the employer’s registered location and activity determine the applicable rules.
translation: Calculator hutumia kuchapishwa 2026 eneo kiwango kwa ajili ya shughuli ya kawaida au kilimo / uvuvi. Inaongeza kuingia likizo malipo, fidia kodi na mchango wowote wa pensheni kwa msingi mchango. Kwa ajili ya shughuli ya kawaida katika eneo Ia, 850,000 NOK kwa kila-biashara tofauti malipo ni kutumika kwa kiasi aliingia kama tayari kutumika mwaka huu. Matokeo ni makadirio ya kila mwaka mipango; mahali mfanyakazi aliyesajiliwa na shughuli kuamua sheria zinazotumika.
